contradicted_or_unsupported_claims: Millions Face Crippling Delays in Social Security Processing

The July 2025 timing and claimed catastrophic new backlog are contradicted by Social Security Administration performance releases. On July 7 and July 23, SSA reported that its initial disability backlog had fallen about 25% from 1.2 million to roughly 940,000-950,000 cases, with improved processing and hearing wait times. I did not find support for millions facing newly crippling delays caused by July DOGE cuts.
